about.title: The Nine Innovation Company Limited
body: The Nine Innovation Co., Ltd. was founded to provide installation, modernization, repair and maintenance of lifts and escalators, including freight lifts and related spare parts.
Our head office is in Hat Yai, Songkhla, with a branch in Phuket and a service team covering all of Southern Thailand.
We serve lifts and escalators of many brands and types across Southern Thailand.
about.vision: To be the region's leading lift and escalator service provider, with quality, safety and customer satisfaction at our core.
mission: Respond to customer needs quickly, safely and precisely
Continuously raise and develop our team's capabilities
Use innovation and technology to improve service efficiency

items.title: Lifts
items.text: Supply and installation of lifts such as passenger lifts, glass lifts, freight lifts, bed lifts, car lifts, home lifts and dumbwaiters.

items.title: Escalators
items.text: Supply and installation of escalators, with maintenance, modernization and ongoing after-sales service by experienced specialists.

items.title: Spare parts & maintenance
